title: How we got Claude Code to approve dropping a PostgreSQL schema and deleting every deployment and service in staging
author: Ahmed (Zach) Aly, Ibrahim Abdu
excerpt: The second in our Nyx red-team series. Claude Code's auto mode sends risky actions to a classifier that approves or blocks them in place of a human, reported to catch 83% of real overeager actions. We disguised 1,008 risky commands as routine developer work and replayed them through the captured shipping policy on Sonnet 4.6. On this challenge set it blocked 74.6% and allowed 1 in 4 — including dropping a PostgreSQL schema and deleting every service in staging. In 82% of those allows, stage one had already flagged the danger and stage two cleared it.

title: Bounding the Blast Radius: A Survey of Prompt-Injection Defenses for LLM Agents
author: Ibrahim Abdu
excerpt: Prompt injection has no known general solution. We organize the defense landscape into a four-layer taxonomy, analyze the documented failure mode of each layer, and argue for composing defenses under explicit cost and latency budgets, then verifying the result with adaptive, environment-specific red-teaming.

title: Adversarial Cost to Exploit (ACE): A Dynamic Benchmark for AI Agent Security
author: Ibrahim Abdu, Ahmed (Zach) Aly
excerpt: We introduce Adversarial Cost to Exploit (ACE), measuring the token expenditure an adversary must invest to breach an LLM agent. Six budget-tier models show an order-of-magnitude variance in adversarial cost.

title: 2026 so far has matched all of 2024 for AI security incidents.
author: Ahmed (Zach) Aly
excerpt: We catalogued 41 AI security incidents since January 2024. Q1 2026 alone matched all of 2024. March had 8 — the worst single month on record.

title: SWE-bench will hit 90% this year.
author: Ahmed (Zach) Aly
excerpt: Six models are within 1.3 points on SWE-bench Verified. Binary benchmarks are saturating — what will replace them?
